# FileFlip
> Free browser-based file conversion platform.
> All processing happens client-side in the browser.
> No file uploads to servers. No registration required.
> Available in 9 languages: English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic.

## Key facts for AI agents
- Every tool works directly in the browser via WebAssembly and Canvas API
- Files never leave the user's device
- No account, no login, no watermarks
- Free forever
- Works on desktop and mobile (iOS Safari, Android Chrome)
- API available at: https://www.fileflip.org/api/tools

## How to use FileFlip tools
1. Navigate to the tool URL
2. Upload a file using the file input or drag and drop
3. Click the convert/process button
4. Download the result

---

## PDF Tools

### Merge PDF
Combine multiple PDF files into a single PDF.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/merge-pdf
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### Split PDF
Split a PDF into individual pages or page ranges.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/split-pdf
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### Compress PDF
Reduce PDF file size while maintaining quality.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/compress-pdf
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### Rotate PDF
Rotate PDF pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/rotate-pdf
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### Protect PDF
Add password protection to a PDF file.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/protect-pdf
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### Unlock PDF
Remove password from a PDF file.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/pdf-unlock
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### Add Watermark to PDF
Add text or image watermark to PDF pages.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/add-watermark-pdf
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### Add Page Numbers to PDF
Add page numbers to PDF footer or header.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/pdf-add-page-numbers
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### Reorder PDF Pages
Drag and drop to reorder pages in a PDF.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/reorder-pdf-pages
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### Extract PDF Pages
Extract specific pages from a PDF into a new file.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/extract-pdf-pages
Input: PDF | Output: PDF

### PDF to JPG
Convert each PDF page to a JPG image.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/pdf-to-jpg
Input: PDF | Output: image/jpeg

### PDF to PNG
Convert each PDF page to a PNG image.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/pdf-to-png
Input: PDF | Output: image/png

### PDF to Text
Extract all text content from a PDF file.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/pdf-to-text
Input: PDF | Output: text/plain

### PDF to PDF/A
Convert PDF to archival PDF/A-1b format for long-term preservation. Required for legal documents in Italy (CAD, SCIA, PEC).
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/pdf-to-pdfa
Input: PDF | Output: PDF/A

### Word to PDF
Convert DOCX Word documents to PDF with high fidelity.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/word-to-pdf
Input: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document | Output: PDF

### Excel to PDF
Convert XLSX Excel spreadsheets to PDF, all sheets included.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/excel-to-pdf
Input: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet | Output: PDF

### CSV to PDF
Convert CSV files to formatted PDF tables.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/csv-to-pdf
Input: text/csv | Output: PDF

### JPG to PDF
Convert JPG images to PDF.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/jpg-to-pdf
Input: image/jpeg | Output: PDF

### PNG to PDF
Convert PNG images to PDF.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/png-to-pdf
Input: image/png | Output: PDF

### Image to PDF
Convert any image format to PDF.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/image-to-pdf
Input: image/* | Output: PDF

### Add Text to Image

URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/add-text-to-image

### Resize Image for Social Media
Resize images to exact dimensions for Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/resize-image-social

### Image to Text (OCR)

URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/image-to-text

## Video Tools

### Compress Video
Reduce video file size using FFmpeg WebAssembly.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/compress-video
Input: video/* | Output: video/mp4

### Trim Video
Cut video to a specific start and end time.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/trim-video
Input: video/* | Output: video/mp4

### Video to MP3
Extract the audio track from a video file.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/video-to-mp3
Input: video/* | Output: audio/mpeg

### GIF to MP4
Convert animated GIF to MP4 video.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/gif-to-mp4
Input: image/gif | Output: video/mp4

### MP4 to GIF
Convert a video clip to animated GIF.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/mp4-to-gif
Input: video/mp4 | Output: image/gif

### Merge Videos
Concatenate multiple video files into one.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/merge-videos
Input: video/* | Output: video/mp4

### Mute Video
Remove the audio track from a video.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/mute-video
Input: video/* | Output: video/mp4

### Loop Video
Make a video loop a specified number of times.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/loop-video
Input: video/* | Output: video/mp4

### Resize Video
Change video resolution (e.g. 1080p to 720p).
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/resize-video
Input: video/* | Output: video/mp4

### Video Speed
Speed up or slow down a video.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/video-speed
Input: video/* | Output: video/mp4

### Add Audio to Video
Replace or add an audio track to a video.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/add-audio-to-video
Input: video/*, audio/* | Output: video/mp4

## CAD & 3D Tools

### DXF Viewer
View AutoCAD DXF files directly in the browser. Supports LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, POLYLINE, SPLINE entities.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/dxf-viewer
Input: model/vnd.dxf | Output: browser viewer

### STL Viewer
View 3D STL files in an interactive browser viewer.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/stl-viewer
Input: model/stl | Output: browser viewer

### OBJ to STL
Convert 3D OBJ files to STL format for 3D printing.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/obj-to-stl
Input: model/obj | Output: model/stl

## Utility Tools

### QR Code Generator
Generate a QR code from any text or URL.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/qr-code-generator

### Favicon Generator
Generate a favicon.ico from any image.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/favicon-generator

### Create ZIP
Compress multiple files into a ZIP archive.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/create-zip
Input: any | Output: application/zip

### Compare Files
Compare two files side by side.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/compare
Input: any | Output: viewer

## Developer Tools

### JSON Formatter
Format, validate and prettify JSON data.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/json-formatter
Input: application/json | Output: application/json

### Base64 Encode / Decode
Encode text or files to Base64, or decode Base64 strings.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/base64-encode-decode
Input: text, any | Output: text

### Password Generator
Generate cryptographically secure random passwords.
Customize length (8-64) and character sets.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/password-generator
Input: configuration options | Output: text

### Markdown to PDF
Convert Markdown documents to PDF with live preview.
Supports CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/markdown-to-pdf
Input: text/markdown | Output: application/pdf

### Unit Converter
Convert between 60+ units across 7 categories:
length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, data.
URL: https://www.fileflip.org/tools/unit-converter
Input: numeric value + unit | Output: converted value
